name: upward-stats
description: Per-prompt/per-call token usage and cost tracking for Claude Code sessions. A Stop/SubagentStop hook parses the session transcript and appends a usage table — tokens by type, estimated USD, and model, per row — to .upward/UPWARD-STATS.md; the /upward-stats skill toggles it on/off, switches between call- and task-level detail, and cleans up archived tables. Standalone — works with or without the upward operating-discipline plugin.
